about_the_game:
Scraptory is a base-building RTS game with a twist: when you extract all the resources in an area or get overrun by enemies, your castle-factory can simply stand up and walk away. There is a world to explore, secrets to discover, and factions to interact with. Scraptory is set on a planet that only had medieval technology before it was turned into an intergalactic dumping ground.

Sit down and deploy anywhere. Enemy attacks are triggered by and scale with your base's industrial activity in each unique location. You decide where to explore and build.

Use the resources you produce to complete objectives, upgrade your base, or sell them to the same corporations and smugglers responsible for turning your once-idyllic planet into a dangerous wasteland. Attempt to escape, join them in exploiting it, or try to save your world and its people. You decide.

Current Features

  • Unique combination of game mechanics from multiple genres.

  • Build pop-up factories to extract and process resources.

  • Deploy and upgrade defenses.

  • Original soundtrack by The Lunks.

  • Trade resources.

  • Explore a large lore filled world.

  • A tutorial

Planned Features during Early Access

  • More upgrades and automation.

  • More unique locations, objectives, and missions.

  • Diplomacy: trade with locals, recruit them, or crush their villages underfoot.

  • Escape your forgotten and doomed planet, join in exploiting it, or try to save it.

  • More music, more polish, more optimization.

Lore

Your generation has never known their home before trash started raining from the sky. A once-idyllic and primitive planet where the sky was the edge of the known universe. Now, countless objects burn through the atmosphere day and night while hulking derelict space ships and stations shatter on the ground, dangerous substances and creatures sometimes spilling out of them.

No one knew the cause of the onslaught until now. After you reactivated and began living inside one of the fallen machines. It started receiving radio transmissions from another world, automated transmission demanding strange payments. You answered and learned that your world had been unknowingly sold as a galactic corporation's scrap heap.

With the advanced machinery on board, you built a fortress, automated factory, and home that can roam the land. Now, what you do with it is up to you.

short_description: Pilot a walking castle-factory built from a crashed asteroid mining ship. Mine and refine resources across a vast open world. Fight alien swarms. Cut deals with the ruthless space corporation that sold your home.
